title: The south in 5 days
summary: Ho Chi Minh City plus either Can Tho, Phu Quoc, or Da Lat. Not all three.

days.title: Day 1 — Ho Chi Minh City
days.body: Walk the cathedral square, Nguyen Hue, the Reunification Palace, and Ben Thanh Market.

days.title: Day 3 — One add-on
days.body: Go to Can Tho for the night, or take Phu Quoc or Da Lat if that is the one add-on you booked.

days.title: Day 4 — Cai Rang
days.body: Take the boat to Cai Rang at dawn, then visit the Binh Thuy ancient house.

days.title: Day 5 — Tan Son Nhat
days.body: Return for the flight from Tan Son Nhat, unless you fly out of the add-on city.

seoDescription: Ho Chi Minh City and one of Can Tho, Phu Quoc, or Da Lat.
